sloka: शत्रोः प्रख्यातवीर्यस्य रञ्जनीयस्य विक्रमैः ।पश्यतो युद्धलुब्धो ऽहं कृतः कापुरुषस्त्वया ।। ६.१०६.६ ।।
transliteration: śatroḥ prakhyātavīryasya rañjanīyasya vikramaiḥ ।paśyato yuddhalubdho 'haṁ kṛtaḥ kāpuruṣastvayā ।। 6.106.6 ।।

translations.english: "While my adversary's valour is widely known, you brought me back like a timid one, while I love war, while I am to be praised in the presence of my enemy."
